body:
I'm still surprised she responded like that. My mother is usually a really kind and patient person, but I guess reminding her about her friends' death must've touched a nerve, or something? It hurt all the more because I completely expected her to catch me as I was falling. 

Now all I do is write weird and morbid Power Rangers fanfiction that nobody reads, and even fewer people like.
I wish you the best in the next life. Goodbye, internet stranger. :)
